# grouper Provider

Manage Internet2 Grouper folders/stems, groups, and direct memberships through the Grouper Web Services REST API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    grouper = {
      source = "notlimahrelyt/grouper"
    }
  }
}

# Credentials are read from GROUPER_USERNAME and GROUPER_PASSWORD in the
# environment; base_url may be set here or via GROUPER_BASE_URL.
provider "grouper" {
  base_url = "https://grouper.example.edu/grouper-ws/servicesRest"

  # request_timeout      = "30s"
  # insecure_skip_verify = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `base_url` (String) Base URL of the Grouper Web Services REST endpoint, e.g. "https://grouper.example.edu/grouper-ws/servicesRest". May also be set with the GROUPER_BASE_URL environment variable.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Disable TLS certificate verification. Defaults to false. Enabling this is insecure and should only be used for testing against self-signed development endpoints.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password for the Grouper service account. May also be set with the GROUPER_PASSWORD environment variable. Prefer the environment variable so the secret does not appear in configuration.
- `request_timeout` (String) Per-request timeout as a Go duration string (e.g. "30s", "1m"). Defaults to "30s". May also be set with the GROUPER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT environment variable.
- `username` (String) Username for the Grouper service account. May also be set with the GROUPER_USERNAME environment variable.
- `ws_version` (String) Grouper Web Services API version path segment (e.g. "v2_6_000"). Defaults to "v2_6_000", which is confirmed against Grouper 4.16. Set this if your deployment requires a different version segment.
